dslRule:
<!id: modernize.asyncContentAssistant>
<!description: Replace the constructor call for the removed AsyncContentAssistant class with the new ContentAssistant(true) constructor for asynchronous behavior.>
<!severity: WARNING>

new org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.AsyncContentAssistant()
=>
new org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ContentAssistant(true)
;;
summary: Replaces direct instantiation of the removed `AsyncContentAssistant` class with the `ContentAssistant(true)` constructor, which now manages asynchronous behavior.
